title: El mosaico biológico: Bosques nubosos, manglares y volcanes
goal: Analyze Costa Rica's isthmian bio-bridge geography, cloud forest microclimates, and national park ecosystems using physical-geographic vocabulary.
grammar: Léxico de biodiversidad y geografía física costarricense

sections.title: Unit 7: Costa Rica — Lesson 1
body: Welcome to lesson 1 of Unit 7 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Costa Rica: Demilitarization, Biodiversity & Democratic Welfare.
In this lesson, we explore el mosaico biológico: bosques nubosos, manglares y volcanes, examining the country's environmental, civic, and economic models.

items: Analyze Costa Rica's isthmian bio-bridge geography, cloud forest microclimates, and national park ecosystems using physical-geographic vocabulary.
Master the terminology and syntax of biodiversidad-costarricense-geografia.
Deploy advanced socio-environmental vocabulary (el puente biológico, el bosque nuboso).
